implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/audit/AuditExport.tsx: Export button with dropdown menu (CSV, JSON). On click: fetches all filtered results (not just current page) via useAuditExport(). CSV: builds CSV string with headers, proper escaping (quotes around fields with commas). JSON: serializes as JSON array. Triggers browser download via Blob + URL.createObjectURL + programmatic anchor click. Button shows loading spinner while fetching.
implementationPlan.note: Created AuditExport with dropdown (CSV/JSON), fetches all filtered results (no pagination), spinner while fetching, outside-click to close dropdown.

implementationPlan.note: Created toCsv (with proper escaping for commas/quotes/newlines) and downloadFile (Blob + createObjectURL + anchor click).
